about: Example plan for paint_chunks.py: three chunks of a one-take. Cut chunks at whip peaks (view turn > 120 deg/s) or where a near surface fills > 60 % of the view; each chunk plus 2 x 8 handle frames must stay under 15 s.
look: Turn this 3D render into real live-action footage shot on a cinema camera, neutral daylight white balance (no yellow cast), fine natural grain, true-to-life colour. Real skin, real hair, real fabric with natural folds.
keep: Keep the camera move, the framing, the timing, the layout and every person's position, path, clothes colour and motion exactly the same. No logos, no stray signs, no watermark.

chunks.prompt: Aerial footage of a real modern city of glass and stone towers; the camera dives down a real reflective glass facade.
First-person view walking through a real bright office lobby: polished stone floor, timber wall, steel turnstiles, real people walking.
First-person view inside a real brushed-steel lift cab with a mirror wall and a floor display.
chunks.text_keep: The floor display is a black glass panel with glowing amber digits: keep it black, keep the amber digits and keep the numbers exactly as they are in every frame.
